title: Infra Hygiene: Raster Project Json, Remodel Launch Entries, Note Plugin Lockfile Cleanup
description: Three independent infra hygiene fixes: 1) Add missing raster/rs/project.json modeled on sibling Rust/WASM crates. 2) Add missing "remodel" trio (⚛️react, 🧊wgpu🌐wasm, 🧊wgpu🖥️native) entries to .vscode/launch.json under 3_dev group. 3) Remove wrongly-committed note/plugin/rs/Cargo.lock and target/ (the only plugin crate with these checked in), and check whether root .gitignore covers this pattern. (Intended parent: 26/07/17/GENERALIZE-APPS-ONTO-FRAMEWORK-PRIMITIVES, but ticket_open rejected it with "ticket not found" despite the folder existing on disk and being tracked in git — opened as a standalone ticket instead.)
summary:
Three independent infra hygiene fixes:
1) Created raster/rs/project.json (was missing) modeled on draw/rs (same-depth sibling), containing only a "wasm" nx:run-commands target since raster/rs/script.ts's ScriptRouter only registers "wasm" (no "test" command) — confirmed nx recognizes it via `bun nx show project @semio-tech/raster-rs`.
2) Added the missing "remodel" trio (⚛️react/🧊wgpu🌐wasm/🧊wgpu🖥️native) to .vscode/launch.json under group "3_dev" at the next free order slot (389/389.1/389.2, immediately after the note/writer block and before order-390 ui-typecheck), using emoji 🏺 (matching remodel/plugin/rs/lib.rs's existing docstring emoji) and fresh port 6063/6163 (verified unused).
3) Deleted note/plugin/rs/Cargo.lock and note/plugin/rs/target/ via plain filesystem rm (no git command). Found target/ was already covered by .gitignore's "target/" and "target*" rules and was untracked (git check-ignore confirms, git ls-files showed nothing) — pure local artifact, no git action needed. Found Cargo.lock is NOT covered by any .gitignore pattern (no Cargo.lock rule exists) and IS currently tracked by git (git ls-files shows it) — flagging for a human: run `git rm --cached note/plugin/rs/Cargo.lock` to untrack it, and consider adding a `**/Cargo.lock` exclusion (with an explicit re-include for the workspace-root Cargo.lock if that one is intentionally tracked) to .gitignore so this can't recur. I did not edit .gitignore or run any git command per the no-mutating-git-commands rule.

Note: the intended parent ticket 26/07/17/GENERALIZE-APPS-ONTO-FRAMEWORK-PRIMITIVES exists on disk and in git but ticket_open rejected it with "ticket not found" (likely an indexing lag in the repo MCP) — this ticket was opened standalone instead.

Also observed (pre-existing, out of scope, not touched): note/plugin/rs/lib.rs was modified concurrently by another process during this session (unrelated to Cargo.lock/target removal); and .vscode/launch.json line ~2199 has draw's 🧊wgpu🖥️native entry pointing at "native s" instead of "native draw" — a likely pre-existing bug, left untouched as out of scope.
